header: This is what the main search engine does when its hybrid (vector + keyword) pipeline fails. The bug this replaces: a database connection that took longer than 5 s to open (typical on the first request after the dev server swaps its pool) made the pipeline throw; the engine logged it, quietly switched to a title-only search, found nothing, and the screen said "No results found" -- which is FALSE. The database had recovered a second later; a second try would have answered.
1. I RETRY a transient database error (connection timeout, dropped connection ...) (3 tries, 400 ms apart). Real errors are not retried.
2. If it still fails, I use the title-only search as a degraded answer -- if it finds something, that is shown.

3. If it finds NOTHING, the search has FAILED and must not pretend there are no results: I throw SearchUnavailableError, the route answers 503 and the screen shows its red "Failed to perform search. Please try again." banner.

symbols.name: hybridWithFallback
symbols.sig: export async function hybridWithFallback<R>( hybrid: () => Promise<EngineResult<R>>, titleFallback: () => Promise<R[]>, opts: { attempts?: number; delayMs?: number; log?: (message: string, err: unknown) => void } = {},): Promise<EngineResult<R>>

params.name: opts
params.type: { attempts?: number; delayMs?: number; log?: (message: string, err: unknown) => void }

behaviours: one connection timeout, then success: the FULL answer is returned (not the title fallback)
two timeouts, then success on the third try
no failure: the hybrid answer is returned and the fallback is never called
a hybrid search that finds nothing is a normal empty answer, not a failure (no exception)
all 3 tries time out but the title search finds a circular: it is shown, marked as a fallback
every try times out AND the fallback finds nothing: SearchUnavailableError (reason 'database') instead of an empty answer
its message is plain English for the reader and does not show the technical error
the original error is kept for the logs
a quota/service error is NOT retried (1 try) and, with an empty fallback, is reported as a search-service problem
a real error with a useful title fallback: the fallback is shown, as before
if the title fallback itself throws, that error comes out (never a silent empty answer)
the failure is still written to the server log
